title: At Least 107 Killed in Gold Mine Collapse in Eastern Cameroon
text:
At Least 107 Killed in Gold Mine Collapse in Eastern Cameroon"

"At least 107 people have lost their lives following the collapse of a traditional gold mine in the Zamboy region in eastern Cameroon, near the border with the Central African Republic."

"The mayor of Garoua-Boulai announced that this number of bodies has been recovered from the rubble so far."

"The incident occurred on Tuesday afternoon, and rescue and search operations are continuing to find any individuals who may still be trapped under the debris.
